Risk: Hosting region or residency rule not met by the cloud service
Mitigation: Confirm region and reports first (ADR-01); fallback to masked-only data
Pseudonymise before load; key kept in source domain; role limits

Risk: Source tables incomplete or change log not enabled
Mitigation: DQ-01 and DQ-08; early extract test

Risk: Too many false alarms; auditors lose trust
Mitigation: Tune thresholds; track K-03; start with 5 tests

Risk: Beta or roadmap feature changes or is withdrawn
Mitigation: Keep out of critical path (P-AI2); label on slides
Monitor allowance; limit assistant to analysts

Risk: Object model too complex to maintain
Mitigation: Start with six objects; document in dictionary

Risk: External auditor does not rely on the evidence
Licensing or capacity cost higher than planned
Mitigation: Size by event volume early; confirm with vendor
